bio.title: Biography
bio.lead: I'm Rahul Jaiswal — a marketing manager who treats every brand like a product to be crafted, not just promoted.
paragraphs: Over the past few years I've led marketing, branding and creative for fast-moving real estate and technology brands. My work spans strategy and execution: campaign concepts, brand identity, websites, SEO, social media, corporate brochures, standees, presentations and video.
I believe great marketing is equal parts **clarity** and **craft** — a clear message, delivered beautifully and consistently across every channel. That's how brands earn attention and keep trust.
Whether it's a knowledge series that builds authority, a hiring campaign that attracts the right people, or a website that ranks and converts, I own the idea from insight to launch.
